messages:
sam (Product): heads up: planning to relocate to Lisbon on 2025-06-10. couple quick things: 1) can i keep the WFH stipend and ship my work laptop to Portugal? 2) will i be moved onto portuguese payroll or can i stay on contractor pay? 3) any gaps in health coverage i should plan for?

jamie (People Ops): congrats, sam! short answers: 1) stipend = yes but we switch to EMEA band and pay in local currency where possible; we also reimburse one-time shipping for company assets if you submit the shipping form. 2) we aim to move headcount to local payroll for employees; we only keep contractor status in rare cases (must be pre-approved). 3) there may be a short coverage transition depending on plan enrollment windows. please fill the Location Change form and tick the "ship equipment" box.

sam (Product): cool. what's the EMEA band amount for Portugal? and how do we handle currency conversion & pay date alignment?

kevin (Finance): EMEA WFH baseline for Portugal is A372/month (paid as A3 equivalent where payroll can't pay euros). we typically convert using the company's FX rate on the payout date. payroll move: if your local payroll start is 2025-06-10, final US pay will include earnings through 2025-06-09. critical dates: paperwork + bank details required by 2025-05-15.

ana (typo) -- oops, ana (Benefits): health note: Redwood offers local private plan in Portugal but enrollment takes ~21 days from payroll activation. you might need short-term travel insurance for days 2025-06-10 through 2025-07-01. we'll trigger benefits enrollment once payroll is confirmed.

sam (Product): what about social security and employer contributions in Portugal? and is there any chance this creates a tax nexus for the company because i'm on the GTM team occasionally doing demos for EU prospects?

legal (Legal): social security = yes, employer and employee contributions apply under Portuguese law once on local payroll. regarding nexus: single engineering/product headcount is usually low risk, but sales/demo activities can increase exposure. please declare any customer-facing meetings, contract-signing, or local office space usage on the form. Legal will run a quick nexus scan and advise.

sam (Product): i do ~2-3 demos/month with EU prospects. i added that to the form.

payroll-bot: Location Change form received: LCF-5890 for sam (submitted 2025-04-02). Current status: People Ops review pending.

jamie (People Ops): thanks. action items: sam to upload passport + proof of Portuguese address when available; sam to mark whether company laptop should be shipped or replaced; kevin to prepare payroll migration checklist; ana to plan benefits enrollment & short-term insurance note; legal to run nexus assessment. i'll schedule a 30-min sync for next week. any concerns with equipment shipping (customs/ VAT)?

kevin (Finance): quick FYI on VAT: shipping company laptop from US -> PT usually fine for company-owned equipment, but we need invoice copy for customs. we'll cover any import taxes upfront and reclaim where possible.

sam (Product): thanks all! shipping preferred. i'll upload the shipping address + ETA soon. :shipit:
